muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿حم﴾: the discussion of the disconnected letters (al-ḥurūf al-muqaṭṭaʿa) has preceded at the beginning of Sūrat al-Baqara.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿تنزيل الكتاب من الله العزيز الحكيم﴾: «تنزيل الكتاب» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), or a mubtadaʾ; «من الله»: «من» is a preposition and the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar; and «العزيز الحكيم» are two naʿts (adjectives).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ما خلقنا السماوات والأرض﴾: «ما» is negative; «خلقنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «السماوات» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with kasra; and «الأرض» is conjoined to «السماوات», accusative.
﴿وما بينهما إلا بالحق وأجل مسمى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative, conjoined to «السماوات»; «بينهما» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr). «بالحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «خلقنا» or from its object, or to an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: a creation clothed with the truth; «أجل» is conjoined to «الحق», genitive (majrūr); and «مسمى» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أجل», genitive with an implied (muqaddar) kasra on the alif.
﴿والذين كفروا عما أنذروا معرضون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «الذين» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «عما»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «معرضون»; the clause «أنذروا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e.: from that of which they were warned; «معرضون» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». Or «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: at their being warned of that Day.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿قل أرأيتم ما تدعون﴾: «قل» is an imperative verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); «أرأيتم» is a verb and its fāʿil; «ما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause «تدعون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿من دون الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿أروني﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its object; the clause is a tawkīd (emphasis) of «أرأيتم».
﴿ماذا خلقوا﴾: the clause «ماذا خلقوا» is the second object of «أرأيتم»; «ماذا» is a fronted object of «خلقوا»; or «ما» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «ذا» is a relative noun, its khabar (predicate), and the clause «خلقوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. Or «أروني» is a tawkīd of «أرأيتم», and what is apparent is that «ما تدعون» is the object of «أرأيتم».
﴿من الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خلق».
﴿أم﴾: a conjunction, and it is disconnected (munqaṭiʿa), meaning «بل» plus the hamza of the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), i.e.: nay, do they have a share in the heavens?
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar.
﴿شرك﴾: the postponed mubtadaʾ.
﴿في السماوات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «شرك».
﴿ائتوني﴾: an imperative verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is part of the completion of the speech reported (maqūl).
﴿بكتاب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ائتوني».
﴿من قبل هذا﴾: an adjective of «كتاب».
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿أثارة﴾: conjoined to «بكتاب».
﴿من علم﴾: an adjective of «أثارة».
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كنتم﴾: a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: then bring me (فائتوني).
﴿صادقين﴾: the khabar of «كنتم».

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ومن أضل ممن يدعو من دون الله من لا يستجيب له إلى يوم القيامة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «من» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); «أضل» is the khabar (predicate); «ممن»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أضل»; the clause «يدعو» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «من», with no grammatical position. «من دون الله» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «من» is the object of «يدعو»; the clause «لا يستجيب له» is a ṣila; it has also been said: «مَن» is a complete, described indefinite (nakira tāmma mawṣūfa), and the clause «لا يستجيب له» is an adjective. «إلى يوم القيامة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; and the clause «ومن أضل...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهم عن دعائهم غافلون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «هم» is the mubtadaʾ; «عن دعائهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «غافلون»; «غافلون» is the khabar of «هم»; and the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وإذا حشر الناس كانوا لهم أعداء وكانوا بعبادتهم كافرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb of future time (ẓarf mustaqbal) containing the meaning of condition; the clause «حشر الناس» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; «الناس» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause «كانوا» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it is a non-jussive apodosis. «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw of the plural is its noun; «لهم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «أعداء» is the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «كانوا» is conjoined to the first «وكانوا»; «بعبادتهم»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كافرين»; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), as an annexation of the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its object, i.e.: of their being worshipped; and «كافرين» is the khabar of «كان».

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا بينات قال الذين كفروا للحق لما جاءهم هذا سحر مبين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا» is conjoined to what precedes; «بينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «قال الذين كفروا» is the answer of «إذا», with no grammatical position; «للحق»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قالوا»; it has also been said: the lām in «للحق» is a lām of ṣila, i.e.: on account of the truth. «لما» is a temporal adverb (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a linking [particle]; «جاءهم» is a verb, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), «سحر» is the khabar (predicate), and «مبين» is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause is the speech they reported (maqūl qawlihim).

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿أم يقولون افتراه قل إن افتريته فلا تملكون لي من الله شيئا﴾: «أم» is a disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) conjunction, so it means «بل» plus the hamza of interrogation, the implied form being: nay, do they say he fabricated it?, and the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī). Or «أم» is connected (muttaṣila), in which case a clause must be implied so that the balance [of the alternatives] is sound, the implied form being: do they acknowledge it, or do they say: he fabricated it? The clause «افتراه» is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). «قل» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «إن» is conditional; «افتريته» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «لا» is negative; «تملكون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; «لي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تملكون»; «من الله» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective and was placed before what it describes; and «شيئًا» is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿هو أعلم بما تفيضون فيه﴾: the clause is a ḥāl clause; «هو» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أعلم» is the khabar (predicate); «بما»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أعلم»; and the clause «تفيضون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position.
﴿كفى به شهيدًا بيني وبينكم وهو الغفور الرحيم﴾: «كفى» is a past verb; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) preposition, and the hāʾ is a pronoun, genitive (majrūr) in form, in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; «شهيدًا» is a tamyīz (specification); «بيني» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to «شهيدًا», and «بينكم» is an adverb conjoined to its like; the wāw is a conjunction; «هو» is a mubtadaʾ, and «الغفور الرحيم» are two khabars of it.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿قل ما كنت بدعا من الرسل وما أدري ما يفعل﴾: «قل» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «ما» is negative; «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and «بدعًا» is its khabar (predicate); «من الرسل» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بدعًا»; «ما» is conjoined to the first negative «ما»; «أدري» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن); «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يفعل», read as passive (constructed for one whose agent is not named), is its khabar; and it suspends (muʿalliqa) «أدري» from operating, standing in place of its two objects.
[Translator's note: the speaker of «أدري» is singular; the implied fāʿil would be «أنا», not «نحن». Translated as written.]
﴿بي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يفعل».
﴿ولا بكم﴾: conjoined to it. It has also been said: «ما» in His words «ما يفعل» is a relative noun, accusative (manṣūb), or an interrogative, nominative.
﴿إن أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلي وما أنا إلا نذير مبين﴾: «إن» is negative; «أتبع» is an imperfect verb, nominative, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «ما» is the object of «أتبع»; the clause «يوحي إليّ» is a ṣila (relative clause); the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is negative; «أنا» is the mubtadaʾ; «إلا» is a particle of restriction; «نذير» is the khabar; and «مبين» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿قل أرأيتم إن كان من عند الله وكفرتم به﴾: the clause «أرأيتم» is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), and the two objects of «أرأيتم» are omitted, their implied form being: have you considered your state, if it is such-and-such, are you not wrongdoers? The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is also omitted, its implied form being: then you have done wrong; and the implied form is: are you not wrongdoers? It has been said: the apodosis is «فآمن واستكبرتم»; and it has been said: it is omitted, its implied form being: then who among us is in the right and who is in the wrong? And it has been said: then who is more astray? The noun of «كان» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "it" (هو), and «من عند الله» is its khabar (predicate). «وكفرتم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the clause «كفرتم» is conjoined to the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); it has also been said: it is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). «به»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كفرتم».
﴿وشهد شاهد من بني إسرائيل على مثله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «شهد شاهد» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «من بني إسرائيل» is an adjective of «شاهد»; «على مثله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «شهد», and the pronoun refers to the Quran.
﴿فآمن واستكبرتم إن الله لا يهدي القوم الظالمين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «آمن» is a verb with a latent fāʿil, its implied form being "he" (هو), i.e.: the witness; «استكبرتم» is conjoined to «فآمن»; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is its noun, and the clause «لا يهدي القوم الظالمين» is the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿وقال الذين كفروا للذين آمنوا لو كان خيرا ما سبقونا إليه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قال الذين» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «للذين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قال»; the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «لو» is conditional; «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir), referring to what Muhammad brought; «خيرًا» is its khabar (predicate); «ما» is negative; «سبقونا» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «سبقونا»; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl), and the clause «ما سبقونا إليه» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وإذ لم يهتدوا به فسيقولون هذا إفك قديم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverb of past time attached to something omitted, its implied form being: their obstinacy became manifest, and His words «فسيقولون» are caused by it. It has also been said: «إذ» is an adverb containing the meaning of condition, attached to «سيقولون», which is the apodosis; and it has been said: «إذ» here is causal (li-l-taʿlīl). «لم» is a particle of negation, inversion [to the past] and jussive; «يهتدوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم», the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil. «فسيقولون»: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and the clause «سيقولون» is conjoined to the implied clause «ظهر عنادهم»; or the fāʾ is in the apodosis of the condition of «إذ», if «إذ» is conditional; and if it is causal, the fāʾ is for branching off (tafrīʿ) from the clause «وإذ لم يهتدوا». The sīn is a particle of the future; «يقولون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and a fāʿil; «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), «إفك» is the khabar, and «قديم» is an adjective; and the nominal clause «هذا إفك قديم» is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the speech reported.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿ومن قبله كتاب موسى إمامًا ورحمة﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «من قبله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate); «كتاب موسى» is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «إمامًا ورحمة» are two ḥāls (circumstantials) from «كتاب موسى»; and the clause «ومن قبله...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهذا كتاب مصدق لسانا عربيا لينذر الذين ظلموا وبشرى للمحسنين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ, «كتاب» is the khabar, and «مصدق» is an adjective; «لسانًا» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «مصدق», or from «كتاب», the governing word (ʿāmil) in it being the sense of the pointing; it has also been said: it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «مصدق», and on this view the pointing is to something other than the Quran; and it has been said: it is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: in an Arabic tongue. The lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); «ينذر» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «مصدق»; or the interpreted maṣdar is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). «الذين» is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause «ظلموا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «بشرى» is conjoined to the position of «لينذر», if it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: and it is glad tidings; and «للمحسنين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بشرى».

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿إن الذين قالوا ربنا الله ثم استقاموا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «الذين» is its noun; the clause «قالوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «ربنا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and «الله» is the khabar (predicate), or the reverse; «ثم» is a conjunction; and the clause «استقاموا» is conjoined to the clause «قالوا».
﴿فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون﴾: the fāʾ is a connective (ṣila) [particle] in the khabar of «إن», because of the meaning of condition contained in the relative noun; «لا» is negative; «خوف» is a mubtadaʾ, which it was permissible to begin with although it is indefinite, because the negation precedes it; «عليهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; and the clause «فلا خوف عليهم» is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar of «إن». «ولا»: the wāw is a conjunction and «لا» is negative; «هم» is a mubtadaʾ. «يحزنون» is an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); and the clause «يحزنون» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «هم».

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿أولئك أصحاب الجنة خالدين فيها جزاء بما كانوا يعملون﴾: «أولئك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أصحاب الجنة» is its khabar (predicate); «خالدين فيها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); «جزاء» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: for the sake of recompense, or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: they are recompensed with a recompense; it has also been said: it is a ḥāl. «بما»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جزاء»; «ما» is a relative noun, or maṣdariyya; «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause «يعملون» is its khabar; and the clause is a second khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿ووصينا الإنسان بوالديه إحسانا﴾: «وصينا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «الإنسان» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بوالديه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «وصينا»; «إحسانًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, i.e.: We enjoined him to do good to them, a doing of good; it has also been said: it is a second object of «وصَّينا», since it is made to carry the sense of «ألزمنا» (We obliged); and it has been said: it is accusative as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿حملته أمه كرها﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason (taʿlīliyya) for the injunction mentioned; «حملته أمه» is a past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and a postponed fāʿil; «كرهًا» is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil, i.e.: in a state of hardship; or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: a carrying with hardship.
﴿ووضعته كرها﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿وحمله وفصاله ثلاثون شهرا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); «حمله» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «فصاله» is conjoined to «حمله»; «ثلاثون» is the khabar (predicate); and «شهرًا» is a tamyīz (specification).
﴿حتى إذا بلغ أشده وبلغ أربعين سنة﴾: «حتى» is a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive; «إذا» is an adverb of future time; the clause «بلغ أشده» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; «بلغ» is conjoined to the first «بلغ»; «أربعين» is the mafʿūl bihi; «سنة» is a tamyīz; and a muḍāf must be implied, i.e.: the completion of forty.
﴿قال رب أوزعني أن أشكر نعمتك التي أنعمت علي وعلى والدي وأن أعمل صالحا ترضاه﴾: the clause «قال» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; «رب» is a vocative (munādā) annexed to the omitted yāʾ of the first person, and the vocative particle is omitted; «أوزعني» is a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ); «أن» and what falls within its scope is in the position of an accusative, the object of «أوزعني»; «نعمتك» is the object of «أشكر»; «التي» is an adjective of «نعمتك»; the clause «أنعمت عليَّ» is a ṣila (relative clause); «أن أعمل» is conjoined to «أن أشكر»; «صالحًا» is the mafʿūl bihi of «أعمل», or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e.: he does a righteous deed; and the clause «ترضاه» is an adjective of «عملًا».
﴿وأصلح لي في ذريتي﴾: «أصلح» is conjoined to «أوزعني»; «لي»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «أصلح»; and «في ذريتي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl.
﴿إني تبت إليك وإني من المسلمين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause «تبت» is its khabar; «إليك»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «تبت»; and «إني من المسلمين» is conjoined to «إني تبت إليك».

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿أولئك الذين نتقبل عنهم أحسن ما عملوا﴾: «أولئك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الذين» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «نتقبل عنهم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «أحسن» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «ما» is a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause «عملوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; or «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: the best of their deeds.
﴿ونتجاوز عن سيئاتهم في أصحاب الجنة وعد الصدق الذي كانوا يوعدون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «نتجاوز» is conjoined to «نتقبل», falling within the scope of the ṣila; «عن سيئاتهم»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نتجاوز»; «في أصحاب الجنة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); it has been said of His words «في أصحاب الجنة» that its position is accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl, and it has been said: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted khabar of an implied mubtadaʾ, i.e.: they are among the companions of Paradise. «وعد الصدق» is a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by its implied verb, and it is a maṣdar emphasising the content of the preceding clause; «الذي» is an adjective of «وعد الصدق»; the clause «كانوا يوعدون» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause «يوعدون» is the khabar of «كانوا»; «يوعدون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿والذي قال لوالديه أف لكما﴾: «الذي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) will come later; the clause «قال» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «لوالديه»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قال»; «أف» is a verbal noun with imperfect sense (ism fiʿl muḍāriʿ), meaning "I am fed up" (أتضجر); and «لكما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) in the accusative, because the lām is for clarification (bayān).
﴿أتعدانني أن أخرج وقد خلت القرون من قبلي﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); «تعدانني» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), with a fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «أن أخرج» is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is the second object of «تعدانني», or it is accusative by removal of the preposition; «أخرج» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive). «وقد»: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «خلت القرون» is a verb and its fāʿil; and «من قبلي» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خلت».
﴿وهما يستغيثان الله ويلك آمن إن وعد الله حق فيقول ما هذا إلا أساطير الأولين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; «هما» is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause «يستغيثان» is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is the mafʿūl bihi. «ويلك» is a maṣdar whose verb the Arabs let die out, and the clause is governed by an implied verb of saying, i.e.: they both say, "Woe to you, believe!", and the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl, i.e.: they seek Allah's help, saying. It has been said: «ويل» is a maṣdar whose verb is not used; and it has been said: it is a mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: may Allah fasten your woe upon you. «آمن» is an imperative verb, and it is part of what the two of them say; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «وعد» is its noun, the word of majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «حق» is the khabar of «إن»; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya) for the command, with no grammatical position. The fāʾ conjoins to the omitted verb of saying; «ما» is negative; «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «أساطير الأولين» is the khabar of «هذا»; and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿أولئك الذين حق عليهم القول في أمم قد خلت من قبلهم من الجن والإنس﴾: «أولئك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الذين» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «حق عليهم القول» has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; «في أمم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «عليهم». The clause «قد خلت» is an adjective of «أمم»; «من قبلهم»: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خلت»; and «من الجنة» is a second adjective of «أمم».
[Translator's note: the ayah reads «من الجن»; «من الجنة» in the source appears to be a slip. Translated as written.]
﴿إنهم كانوا خاسرين﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «هم» is its noun, and the clause «كانوا» is its khabar; «خاسرين» is the khabar of «كانوا»; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿ولكل درجات مما عملوا وليوفيهم أعمالهم وهم لا يظلمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «لكل» is a fronted khabar (predicate), and «درجات» is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); «مما» is an adjective of «درجات»; the clause «عملوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and the clause «ولكل درجات» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «وليوفيهم»: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl), and «يوفيهم» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the causal lām; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted thing whose reason is being given, as if it were said: and He recompensed them with that in order to pay them in full. The hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «أعمالهم» is the second mafʿūl bihi. The wāw is circumstantial; «هم» is the mubtadaʾ, and the clause «لا يظلمون» is its khabar; and the clause is accusative as an emphasising ḥāl (ḥāl muʾakkida).

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿ويوم يعرض الذين كفروا على النار أذهبتم طيباتكم في حياتكم الدنيا واستمتعتم بها﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, its implied form being: it will be said to them, "You squandered…", on the day of their being exposed. The clause «يعرض» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; «يعرض» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive); «الذين» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «على النار» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يعرض»; the clause «ويوم يعرض...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «أذهبتم» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «طيباتكم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «في حياتكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أذهبتم»; and «الدنيا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الحياة».
﴿فاليوم تجزون عذاب الهون بما كنتم تستكبرون في الأرض بغير الحق﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; «اليوم» is an adverb of time attached to «تجزون»; «تجزون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), constructed for one whose agent is not named; «عذاب الهون» is the second mafʿūl bihi; «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تجزون»; «ما» is a relative noun, or maṣdariyya; the clause «كنتم» has no grammatical position, and the clause «تستكبرون» is the khabar (predicate) of «كنتم»; «في الأرض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تستكبرون»; and «بغير الحق» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وبما كنتم تفسقون﴾: conjoined to what precedes; «ما» is maṣdariyya, or a relative noun.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿واذكر أخا عاد إذ أنذر قومه بالأحقاف﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «اذكر» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «أخا عاد» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «واذكر أخا عاد» is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «إذ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «أخا عاد»; the clause «أنذر قومه» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and «بالأحقاف» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أخا عاد», i.e.: in the state of their being at al-Aḥqāf.
﴿وقد خلت النذر من بين يديه ومن خلفه﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or parenthetical; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «خلت النذر» is a verb and its fāʿil; «من بين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «خلت»; «يديه»: «يدي» is muḍāf ilayhi, the nūn having been deleted for the annexation, and it is itself a muḍāf, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. «ومن خلفه»: the wāw is a conjunction, the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «خلت», and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «وقد خلت النذر...» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil or from the object, or parenthetical between «أنذر» and «ألا تعبدوا إلا الله», i.e.: he warned them that they should worship none but Allah; so it has no grammatical position.
﴿ألا تعبدوا إلا الله﴾: there are three views on «أن»:
The first: that it is lightened from the heavy [form] (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), and its noun is the omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); its origin is «أنه لا تعبدوا», i.e.: with [the message] that the matter and the discourse is his saying to you: "Do not worship anyone but Allah". The clause «لا تعبدوا..» is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), the khabar (predicate) of the lightened «أن»; «أن» and what falls within its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, its implied form being "saying" (قائلا), which is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «أنذر». «لا» is prohibitive; «تعبدوا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is the mafʿūl bihi.
The second view: that it is a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative; «لا» is negative, and «تعبدوا» is an imperfect verb, accusative by «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya «أن» and what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to something omitted, its implied form being "saying" (قائلا), which is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «أنذر». The clause «لا تعبدوا...» is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya «أن», with no grammatical position.
The third view: that it is explicative (tafsīriyya), because warning carries the sense of saying, and the clause after it is explicative, with no grammatical position.
﴿إني أخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause «أخاف» is its khabar; «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أخاف»; «عذاب يوم» is the mafʿūl bihi; «عظيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم»; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for the prohibition.

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿قالوا أجئتنا لتأفكنا عن آلهتنا﴾: «قالوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī); «جئتنا» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); «تأفكنا» is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جئتنا»; and «عن آلهتنا» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تأفكنا».
﴿فأتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من الصادقين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; «ائت» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the weak letter, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «نا» is the mafʿūl bihi; «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ائت»; the clause «تعدنا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «إن» is conditional; «كنت» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «كنت»: «كان» is a deficient past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; «من الصادقين» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of «كان»; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: then bring us what you promise us.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿قال إنما العلم عند الله﴾: «قال» is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); «إنما» is a restraining [particle] and a restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); «العلم» is the mubtadaʾ (subject); «عند الله» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); and the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وأبلغكم ما أرسلت به ولكني أراكم قوما تجهلون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, i.e.: as for me, my task is only to convey, not to bring the punishment, since I am not able to do that; the only One able to do it is Allah the Exalted. «أبلغكم» is an imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «ما» is a mafʿūl bihi; the clause «أُرْسِلْتُ» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «أرسلت» is a past verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive); «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أرسلت»; the wāw is a conjunction; «لكن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause «أراكم» is its khabar; «قومًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause «تجهلون» is an adjective of «قومًا».

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿فلما رأوه عارضا مستقبل أوديتهم قالوا هذا عارض ممطرنا﴾: the fāʾ conjoins to something implied and omitted; «لما» is a temporal adverb (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a linking [particle]; «رأوه» is a past verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «عارضًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial), because the seeing is visual; it has also been said: a tamyīz (specification). «مستقبل أوديتهم» is a naʿt (adjective), which is permissible because the annexation is not genuine (ghayr maḥḍa), so it does not confer definiteness, and it was therefore acceptable for it to occur as an adjective of an indefinite noun, i.e.: heading and moving towards them. The clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position, because it is the answer of «لما», which contains the meaning of condition in either case. «هذا» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «عارض» is its khabar (predicate); «ممطرنا» is a naʿt of «عارض», the adjective being acceptable for the reason given above, i.e.: one that will rain on us. It has also been said: the pronoun in «رأوه» refers to something not mentioned, which His words «عارضًا» make clear, so the pronoun refers to the clouds, i.e.: when they saw the clouds as a cloud spreading across the sky.
﴿بل هو ما استعجلتم به ريح فيها عذاب أليم﴾: «بل» is a conjunction of digression (iḍrāb); «هو» is the mubtadaʾ; «ما» is a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), khabar; the clause «استعجلتم» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «استعجلتم». «ريح» is a badal (substitute) from «ما», or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: it is a wind; «فيها» is a fronted khabar, «عذاب» is a postponed mubtadaʾ, and «أليم» is a naʿt; and the clause «فيها عذاب أليم» is a naʿt of «ريح».

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿تدمر كل شيء بأمر ربها﴾: the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of «ريح»; «تدمر» is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هي); «كل شيء» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «بأمر» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تدمر»; and «ربها» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فأصبحوا لا يرى إلا مساكنهم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; and if the statement is from Allah the Exalted, the fāʾ is merely conjunctive. «أصبحوا» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is its noun; «لا» is negative; «يرى» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the alif; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «مساكنهم» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and «هم» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿كذلك نجزي القوم المجرمين﴾: «كذلك»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being: with the like of that recompense We recompense the people a recompense. «ذلك»: «ذا» is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi; the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address. «نجزي» is an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "we" (نحن); «القوم» is the mafʿūl bihi; and «المجرمين» is a naʿt of «القوم».

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿ولقد مكناهم فيما إن مكناكم فيه﴾: the wāw is the wāw of oath, and the lām is the answer to the omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «مكناهم» is a verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «فيما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مكناهم»; «ما» is a relative noun meaning «الذي», or described (mawṣūfa). On «إن» there are three views:
The first: it is conditional, and its apodosis (jawāb) is omitted; the conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of «ما», with no grammatical position. The implied form is: in that in which, had We established you in it, you would have transgressed.
The second: that it is redundant (zāʾida), likening the relative «ما» to the negative «ما» and the temporal «ما».
The third: that it is negative, meaning «ما»; the wording departed from the negative «ما» to «إن» only to avoid the coming together of two words identical in form. «مكناكم» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; and «فيه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «مكناكم».
﴿وجعلنا لهم سمعا وأبصارا وأفئدة﴾: «جعلنا» is a verb and its fāʿil; «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «جعلنا», because it means «خلقنا» (We created); «سمعًا» is the mafʿūl bihi; and «أبصارًا وأفئدة» are conjoined to «سمعًا».
﴿فما أغنى عنهم سمعهم ولا أبصارهم ولا أفئدتهم من شيء﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ما» is negative; «أغنى» is a past verb; «عنهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «أغنى»; «سمعهم» is the fāʿil; «ولا أبصارهم ولا أفئدتهم» are conjoined to «سمعهم»; «من» is a connective (ṣila) preposition; and «شيء» is genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, as a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: any availing.
﴿إذ كانوا يجحدون﴾: «إذ» is an adverb of past time attached to «ما أغنى», and it is an adverb that functions as a causal [particle]; the clause «كانوا» is in the position of a genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause «يجحدون» is its khabar (predicate).
﴿بآيات الله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يجحدون».
﴿وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «حاق» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. «بهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «حاق»; «ما» is the fāʿil of «حاق»; the clause «كانوا» is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «كان» is a deficient past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause «يستهزئون» is the khabar of «كان»; and «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يستهزئون».

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿ولقد أهلكنا ما حولكم من القرى وصرفنا الآيات لعلهم يرجعون﴾: the lām is the answer to an omitted oath; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «أهلكنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «ما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «حولكم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. «من القرى» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); «صرفنا» is conjoined to «أهلكنا»; «الآيات» is the mafʿūl bihi; «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) expressing hope (tarajjī); «هم» is its noun; and the clause «يرجعون» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿فلولا نصرهم الذين اتخذوا من دون الله قربانا آلهة﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), equivalent to «هلا»; «نصرهم» is a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الذين» is a postponed fāʿil (agent); the clause «اتخذوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «من دون الله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اتخذوا»; the first object of «اتخذوا» is omitted, and it is the resumptive pronoun (ʿāʾid) of the relative noun; «قربانًا» is accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial); and «آلهة» is the second mafʿūl bihi. It has also been said: the first object is omitted, «قربانًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi, and «آلهة» is a badal (substitute) from it; and it has been said that the meaning is spoiled on this view, without the manner in which the meaning is spoiled being explained; we explain it and say: if «قربانًا» were a second object, — It has also been said: «قربانًا» is parsed as a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and «آلهة» is the second object, the first object being omitted as stated above.
[Translator's note: the source's explanation breaks off after "if «قربانًا» were a second object," and the promised explanation is not given; translated as written.]
﴿بل ضلوا عنهم وذلك إفكهم وما كانوا يفترون﴾: «بل» is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; «ضلوا» is a verb and its fāʿil; «عنهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ضلوا»; the wāw is a conjunction; «ذلك» is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and «إفكهم» is the khabar (predicate); «وما»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «ما» is maṣdariyya, or a relative noun; «كان» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, the wāw of the plural is its noun, and the clause «يفترون» is the khabar of «كان».

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿وإذ صرفنا إليك نفرا من الجن يستمعون القرآن﴾: the wāw is resumptive; or the wāw is a conjunction and the clause is conjoined to the clause «واذكر أخا عاد», conjoining one story to another. «إذ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: and remember when We turned; the clause «صرفنا» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «صرفنا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «إليك» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «صرفنا»; «نفرًا» is the mafʿūl bihi; «من الجن» is an adjective of «نفرًا»; and the clause «يستمعون القرآن» is a second adjective of «نفرًا», or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from it, since it has been specified by the adjective.
﴿فلما حضروه قالوا أنصتوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لما» is a temporal adverb (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or a linking [particle]; «حضروه» is a verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause «قالوا» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; the clause «أنصتوا» is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl); and the pronoun in «حضروه» is for the Quran.
﴿فلما قضي ولوا إلى قومهم منذرين﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «لما» is a temporal adverb, or a linking [particle]; «قضي» is a past verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive), and it is indeclinable on fatḥa, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو). «ولوا» is a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif that was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and the wāw is the fāʿil. «إلى قوم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ولوا»; «هم» is muḍāf ilayhi; «منذرين» is a ḥāl, accusative with the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause «قضي» is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause «ولوا» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿قالوا يا قومنا إنا سمعنا كتابا أنزل من بعد موسى مصدقا لما بين يديه﴾: «قالوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «يا» is a vocative particle, and «قومنا» is a vocative (munādā) in construct; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), «نا» is its noun, and the clause «سمعنا» is its khabar (predicate); «كتابًا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «أنزل» is an adjective of «كتابًا», and it is passive (constructed for one whose agent is not named), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) being latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو); «من بعد» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزل»; «موسى» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «مصدقًا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب»; «لما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «مصدقًا»; «بين» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. «يديه» is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿يهدي إلى الحق وإلى طريق مستقيم﴾: the clause «يهدي» is a second naʿt of «كتابًا», or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from it, because it is described — the rule has been given earlier; «إلى الحق» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يهدي»; and «إلى صراط مستقيم» is conjoined to «إلى الحق».
[Translator's note: the ayah reads «وإلى طريق مستقيم»; «صراط» in the source appears to be carried over from a similar ayah. Translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿يا قومنا أجيبوا﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle, «قومنا» is a vocative (munādā) in construct, and «أجيبوا» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿داعي الله﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وآمنوا﴾: conjoined to «أجيبوا».
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «آمنوا».
﴿يغفر﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab).
﴿لكم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to «يغفر».
﴿من ذنوبكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to «يغفر», i.e.: some of them, so «من» is partitive (li-l-tabʿīḍ).
﴿ويجركم من عذاب أليم﴾: conjoined to what precedes.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ومن لا يجب داعي الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «من» is conditional, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), mubtadaʾ (subject); «لا» is negative; «يجب» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm); and «داعي الله» is its object.
﴿فليس بمعجز في الأرض﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because the apodosis is an inflexible (jāmid) verb; «ليس» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) particle; «معجز» is genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, because it is the khabar (predicate) of «ليس», and its noun is latent (mustatir), referring to «من»; and «في الأرض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «معجز».
﴿وليس له من دونه أولياء﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ليس» is a deficient past verb; «له» is the fronted khabar of «ليس»; «من دونه» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and «أولياء» is the postponed noun of «ليس».
﴿أولئك﴾: mubtadaʾ.
﴿في ضلال﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of «أولئك».
﴿مبين﴾: an adjective.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿أولم يروا أن الله الذي﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (istifhām inkārī), and the wāw conjoins to something implied; «لم» is a particle of negation, inversion [to the past] and jussive; «يروا» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لم»; «أن» and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of «يروا»; «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the word of majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is its noun, and «الذي» is an adjective of «الله».
﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾: «خلق» is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). «السماوات» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «الأرض» is conjoined to «السماوات», accusative (manṣūb). The clause «خلق السماوات» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذي», with no grammatical position.
﴿ولم يعي بخلقهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لم» is a particle of negation, inversion and jussive; «يعي» is an imperfect verb, jussive by «لم»; and «بخلقهن» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعي».
﴿بقادر على أن يحيي الموتى﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) particle; «قادر» is genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, because it is the khabar (predicate) of «أن»; and «على أن يحيي الموتى» is attached to «قادر».
﴿بلى إنه على كل شيء قدير﴾: «بلى» is a particle of reply for cancelling the negation, i.e.: yes indeed, He is able to give life to the dead — as though He had said in the ayah: is not Allah able? «إن» is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and «قدير» is its khabar; and «على كل شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «قدير».

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ويوم يعرض الذين كفروا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted, its implied form being "it will be said to them", and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the clause «يعرض» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; «يعرض» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive); «الذين» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause «كفروا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿على النار أليس هذا بالحق﴾: «على النار» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يعرض»; the clause «أليس هذا بالحق» is the speech of the verb of saying that governs the adverb in the accusative; the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval and rebuke (istifhām inkārī tawbīkhī); «ليس» is a deficient (nāqiṣ) past verb, and «هذا» is its noun; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) particle, and «الحق» is genitive in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position as the khabar (predicate) of «ليس»; and the clause «ويوم يعرض...» is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قالوا بلى وربنا﴾: «قالوا» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «بلى» is a particle of reply for cancelling the negation, i.e.: yes indeed, it is the truth. The wāw is for the oath; «ربنا»: the word is genitive by the wāw of the oath, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an implied verb, its implied form being "I swear" (أقسم).
﴿قال فذوقوا العذاب﴾: «قال» is a past verb; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa; «ذوقوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; and «العذاب» is the object.
﴿بما كنتم تكفرون﴾: «بما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «ذوقوا»; the bāʾ is causal (li-l-sababiyya), and «ما» is maṣdariyya, i.e.: because of your disbelief; «كان» is a deficient past verb, the tāʾ is its noun, and the clause «تكفرون» is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿فاصبر كما صبر أولو العزم من الرسل﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it is the answer to an implied condition, i.e.: if the end of the disbelievers is what has been mentioned, then be patient with their harm. «اصبر» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); «كما»: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), or a ḥāl (circumstantial); «ما» is maṣdariyya; «صبر» is a past verb; the interpreted maṣdar from «ما» and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «أولو العزم» is the fāʿil of «صبر»; and «من الرسل» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl.
﴿ولا تستعجل لهم كأنهم يوم يرون ما يوعدون لم يلبثوا إلا ساعة من نهار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is prohibitive; «تستعجل» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by «لا», and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تستعجل»; the object of «تستعجل» is omitted, its implied form being "the descent of the punishment"; «كأن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and «هم» is its noun; «يوم» is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to the negation conveyed by «لم»; the clause «يرون» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it; «يرون» is an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; «ما» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «يوعدون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; the clause «لم يلبثوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «كأن»; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «ساعة» is an adverb attached to «يلبثوا»; and «من نهار» is an adjective of «ساعة».
﴿بلاغ فهل يهلك إلا القوم الفاسقون﴾: «بلاغ» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: this with which you have been admonished is a communication; it has also been said: its implied form is "this Quran"; so the fāʾ was made conjunctive. «هل» is an interrogative particle meaning negation; «يهلك» is an imperfect verb, constructed for one whose agent is not named (passive); «إلا» is a particle of restriction; «القوم» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and «الفاسقون» is an adjective.
